marine.title: Forecast for Today Tonight and Wednesday.
marine.text:
Wind north 15 knots diminishing to light late this afternoon
then becoming south 15 near noon Wednesday. Wind diminishing to light Wednesday
evening. Scattered showers or scattered flurries ending
overnight. Temperatures near plus 2. <br/>

morning.<br/>
